cohort: Pregnant women, some with a history of breast cancer up to 10 years prior to pregnancy
finding: Women with a history of breast cancer had lower rates of early and late pregnancy loss and no significant differences in most pregnancy-associated disorders compared to women without a history of cancer.
mod_finding: Women with a history of breast cancer had a higher rate of live births compared to controls, suggesting potential differences in mode of delivery, although the specific rates of cesarean section or vaginal birth are not reported in the abstract.
